name: handbuilt-church-labs
description: Church Command Center setup, weekly bulletins, sermon research and reflection, sermon videos, monthly finance reports, and a church brand system.

interface.longDescription: For pastors of small churches. Create a private church folder, prepare source-verified sermon research briefs, write your sermon in your own voice with a light edit, prepare a recorded sermon as a reviewable video, produce worship bulletin booklets for review, build a monthly finance report for the vestry or council from QuickBooks, and design a church brand. It supports Episcopal and Lutheran worship first. It needs a desktop app that can run local files, and a person reviews everything before it is used.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Church Command Center.
